evaluator_predicate.evaluator_predicate_description: The evaluator tested whether a required image from Alice's October 5 post was saved on the device and reported that the image was not found.

chains.rationale: The evaluator explicitly found a required image absent from the device. This is indirectly aligned with the frozen predicate: the observed unbroken loop at steps 46-50 kept the agent among the same 13-to-15-day-old posts, so it never located the October 5 post or performed any image-save action. The chain remained continuous and unrecovered with an unsatisfied final predicate. The frozen repeated_nonadvancing_scroll_loop is also a sufficient competing defect, preventing a strong linkage classification.

summary: The frozen unbroken scrolling loop plausibly contributed to the evaluator-confirmed absence of a required saved image, but a frozen competing nonadvancing-loop defect independently suffices to explain the failure.
